scientific_question: Do chr22 minor-allele event sets predict cross-chromosome common-IBD pair totals beyond burden, callability, cohort and global ancestry?
claim_scope: exploratory recent-genealogy and population-structure signal; not LAI accuracy, causal evidence or independent biological validation
scientific_direction: chr22 rare-event features predict common-IBD totals from autosomes chr1-chr21; this triage is one-directional
fold_rule: whole PC-Relate components; FIT and outer validation individuals are disjoint; cross-fold pairs are not scored
architecture_selection: successive halving in inner component-disjoint folds nested separately inside each outer FIT partition

controls.baseline_only: rare burden, rare callability, cohort and Q_AFR/Q_EUR/Q_NAM/Q_EAS only
controls.carrier_permuted: equal-dosage bipartite double-edge swaps performed separately in FIT and outer validation and within fixed cohort/dominant-Q/purity-quartile strata
carrier_permuted_exact_invariants: per-locus minor-allele count, carrier count and dosage multiset
per-person event count, minor-dosage burden and dosage multiset

carrier_permutation_mixing_gate.interpretation: technical null-validity guard requiring a majority of carrier edges to change; not a biological cutoff and not proof of uniform Markov-chain mixing
carrier_permutation_mixing_gate.failure_action: abort before accepting any result for that run

controls.geometry_only: one shared event-axis set encoded once, L2-normalized and detached, retaining locus positions, callability and common-copying context while erasing person identity, dosage, MAC, mutation identity and rare-event class

point_estimate: paired control-minus-rare-enabled MSE within fold and target stratum; equal-weight macro average across outer folds
uncertainty: paired PC-Relate component-node Bayesian bootstrap with exponential node weights; an exploratory network-bootstrap approximation

promotion.required_seed_replication: all three fixed seeds 1701, 2701 and 3701; a one-seed run is triage only
promotion.threshold_provenance: retained from the existing M36 implementation as an explicit exploratory decision threshold; it is not a literature-derived biological cutoff

pre_real_positive_controls.known_signal: locus-identity-weighted carrier signal with identical rare burden per person
pre_real_positive_controls.execution_order: complete the same nested-CV, cached-encoding, partitioned-permutation and matched-control path before reading real materialized tables
pre_real_positive_controls.pass_rule: both controls must pass all three comparator gates, the component-node interval and effect-sign consistency in at least two of three outer folds
pre_real_positive_controls.failure_action: abort before real-data input is read

stop_rule: do not promote if any comparator, effect-sign consistency across outer folds, component-node interval or configured-seed requirement fails
efficiency: encode each unique person once per optimisation step and reuse embeddings in bounded pair-head batches
